name: Días de Gloria
description: AJ Fernandez honors a time he believes were the glory days of Cuban tobacco. Dias De Gloria is made up of aged tobacco from four of AJ’s oldest farms in Nicaragua: Finca los Cedros, La Providencia 1, La Lilia and La Soledad. All four of these farms are located in Estelí, Nicaragua. “Dias De Gloria is an exceptional Nicaraguan puro that perfectly encapsulates the essence of the pre-Castro glory days of Cuban Tobacco” - AJ Fernandez Días de Gloria AJ Fernandez honors a time he believes were the glory days of Cuban tobacco. name: Días de Gloria Brazil
description: Días de Gloria Brazil celebrates the union of two exceptional worlds of tobacco. Honoring the rich roots of Brazil and the legacy of Nicaragua, AJ Fernandez captures the soul of traditional influences with this distinct and vibrant blend. While adorned with a Brazilian Mata Fina wrapper, AJ’s signature Nicaraguan binder and filler remains at the heart of this blend. In crafting this cigar, AJ Fernandez not only pays tribute to the glory days of tobacco but also will create new glory days for every connoisseur. name: New World Decenio
description: New World Decenio commemorates a decade of legacy, tradition, and passion. In the early years of pioneering his own company, AJ alongside his father, Ismael, developed the New World brand with the intention of illuminating AJ’s distinct blending style and to pay respect to his roots in tobacco. New World quickly became foundation to the company’s recognition and growth, and today, remains the most acclaimed brand in the AJ Fernandez Portfolio. Decenio is a gleaming testament to hard work, a celebration of origins, and a glimpse into everything yet to come.

description: Modern Cuban born cigar maker, AJ Fernandez, is now entrusted to re-blend a classic Cuban cigar brand.
